children: Adam Pollitzer, a reporting person and Chief Executive Officer, sold common shares in open market transactions at an average price of $44.855 per share. The total sale amount reported was $7,746,727. Following the sale, the reporting person directly owns 270,267 common shares, consisting of 147,213 common shares and 123,054 unvested restricted stock units. The sale occurred on 2026-09-04 and involved 172,706 shares sold at prices ranging from $44.51 to $45.16.
